Send us Fan Mail

Hi everyone, we have a new theme this week and that theme is: “before they were famous”.  It’s pretty self explanatory but just to be clear, that means we will be reviewing films where the stars/directors/etc are not necessarily making their debut but significant contributions to the film industry before they became their own brand.

We are kicking things off with The Outsiders.  This is a 1983 Francis Ford Coppola film where In Tulsa, Oklahoma in 1964, the rivalry between two gangs, the poor Greasers and the rich Socs, heats up when one gang member accidentally kills a member of the other.

Once Upon a Time. . .  this podcast occasionally has a Special Guest Host.  And this week is one of those magical weeks!  Matt's sister Kristen joins us for her listener pick:  the 2025 Norwegian body horror film, "The Ugly Stepsister."  This is a twist on the Cinderella story by the Brothers Grimm that explores the lengths someone will go to to be seen as "beautiful." It is visually stunning, darkly gothic and the soundtrack is fantastic.  Think "The Substance" meets the directing style of Emerald Fennell.

We also talk about the definition of body horror, a little bit about old school body modification and there is also a plug for King Richard's Faire!  So try this episode on. . . we might be sole-mates!
